verdicts.item:

statements:
```text
render(v) = escape(v) for every stored value v   -- A19-1
no stored value is ever evaluated or executed   -- A19-2
```
quotes: assert [i["request_text"] for i in items] == [ACCESS_MARKUP]  # stored as given
assert "img" not in page.tags and "zb" not in page.tags
assert all(name not in ("onerror", "src") for _, name, _ in page.attributes)
verdicts.why: The check verifies that this particular stored access-request value is rendered as text and does not become the supplied elements or attributes. It does not establish the universal claim for every stored value, nor does it directly establish that no stored value is ever evaluated or executed.
